name: capstone-binary-patching
description: Instruction-aware binary patching, diffs and rollback through a uv-managed Capstone CLI and focused workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build, diff, verify and reverse binary patches.
interface.longDescription: A skill and CLI for native binary patch construction, instruction-aware diffs, patch porting and rollback. Uses uv-managed Capstone and LIEF with optional Keystone assembly. Includes PE, ELF, Mach-O, firmware and analysis-copy workflows, hash-bound patch plans, and reproducible native Windows experiments. No MCP server or account connection.
defaultPrompt: Use Capstone Binary Patching to create and validate a reversible binary patch.
